library: geo (georust), with i_overlay for boolean operations
options: geo with its default features (earcut, spade, multithreading); run.sh sets RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1
serde_json with float_roundtrip, so every coordinate parses to the exact double (the default fast path can be 1 ulp off)

precision.grid: 2^-28 * H: i_overlay's step is 2^(round(log2 H) - 29) <= 2^-28.5 H, H = the largest half-extent of the joint bounding box of A and B (scale = 2^(29 - round(log2 H)))
